page.notes: Running head and catchword are as printed; the catchword "cabi" begins the next word "revocabilem" and is the only catchword. The Greek phrase after "&" in paragraph 2 is not legible to me letter by letter; the portion "εἰς τὸ ἀλληγορῶ" is my best reading and is marked [?]. "tremendâ" carries a doubtful mark over the final vowel. Printed hyphens at line ends are kept as shown ("mutabi-", "immuta-", "na-", "fuissent" etc. as printed). Long s is rendered as plain s throughout; s appears in the source only as the printer's long s and is normalised. The soft hyphen in "præde­stinatione" marks a line-end break that I could not confirm; the word is probably "prædestinatione" without a printed hyphen.
